entry.title: Trust Fund Commission: the meeting of 10 September 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: Trust commission accuses school committee of illegally withholding scholarship fund records; dispute unresolved. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7wCeOTdyvdc), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.
